answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, with the bond slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities. Like a glacier, the cost moves slowly but crushes cheap copies: an attacker must fund every fake separately, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand bonds. A signed sonnet of provenance, a verifiable history of past work, proves the bond belongs to a real track record rather than a fresh plume of throwaway accounts that vanish after one scam.
